subject: Re: Pilot ramp waterfall, escrowed credits & conversion pricing
messages:
From: Leanne Wu <leanne@brightpath.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightpath.ai
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot proposal + MAP draft and ask about escrowed credits

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for yesterday's demo — the team left impressed with latency and the batching options. We're ready to move to a 8-week pilot but need to formalize success criteria and commercial terms. I've attached a first-pass MAP (MAP_BrightPath_v1.pdf) with milestones tied to acceptance and ramp targets.

Two asks up front:
- Can Redwood hold POC credits in escrow (we'd prefer the credits be released on milestone acceptance rather than paid upfront)?
- If we hit the agreed SLA / accuracy thresholds and convert, what pricing bands apply at 100k, 500k, and 1M tokens / month?

Procurement is copied for visibility — they'll need a PO template early if we proceed.

Proposed kickoff: next Tuesday, 5/4.

Thanks,
Leanne
Leanne Wu
Head of AI Delivery, BrightPath AI

Attachment: MAP_BrightPath_v1.pdf (PDF, 480KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Leanne Wu <leanne@brightpath.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-01T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal + MAP draft and ask about escrowed credits

Leanne — really glad the demo clicked. High level response to your asks:

1) Escrowed POC credits: we can do a time-boxed escrow arrangement. Redwood will earmark a credit pool (value equivalent) and release tranches upon sign-off of each MAP milestone. We treat this as a refund/credit liability on our side, and it requires a short escrow addendum (1 page).

2) Milestone structure: recommend 4 gates for an 8-week pilot — Kickoff (onboarding), Core Integration (end of wk2), Performance Acceptance (end of wk5), Production Readiness (end of wk8). Each gate releases 25% of the escrowed credits on acceptance. Acceptance will be a short checklist (SLOs + sample prompt set).

3) Conversion pricing bands (preliminary):
- 0–100k tokens/month: $0.020 /k token equivalent pricing (reference)
- 100k–500k: $0.015 /k token equivalent
- 500k–1M+: custom tier with committed discount (example: $0.012 /k with 3–6 month commit)

We can offer a one-time 30-day free trial extension if you need runway to validate the Performance Acceptance milestone.

Operational asks from us: a sample prompt set and representative traffic profile (peak/minute and token distribution) so we can pre-size capacity.

If you're okay with the escrow + milestone ladder, I'll have Laura (legal) draft the 1‑page escrow addendum + MAP revision and push a DocuSign link. Rishi will own the commercial terms and finalize the pricing in the SOW.

Next steps: confirm kickoff date (5/4 works for us) and whether procurement prefers a PO-first or signature-first flow.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Karthik — thanks, that ladder makes sense. A couple of clarifying redlines from procurement and product:

- Can the Performance Acceptance gate include a fail-fast clause allowing BrightPath to exit within 48 hours of a material SLO miss and prorate credits? We need an explicit carve-out in case integration shows regressions.
- On the conversion tiers: procurement asked for an additional anchored option — a 12‑month committed discount (we'd like a 10% additional discount over the 500k tier if we commit to a 12-month volume).
- I attached our PO template — procurement prefers signature + PO (they need the PO number for internal routing).

If you can add the fail-fast language and the 12-month anchor to the MAP, we can sign the escrow addendum and issue the PO for the escrowed credit amount.

Thanks,
Leanne

- 12-month anchor: If BrightPath converts and signs a 12-month volume commitment, an additional 10% discount is applied on top of the 500k tier pricing; we'll list this as an optional discount in the SOW.
- Escrow release schedule: 25% at each gate on sign-off; sign-offs to be recorded in the shared Drive folder.
